title: Many-to-one (N:1)
summary: Many orders belong to one customer.
description:

Why: Many-to-one is the same FK pattern viewed from the child — reinforcing that cardinality is about perspective, not a different physical mechanism.
hints: N:1 is the same FK pattern as 1:N from the child.
